reply:
Based on the image provided, the answer is **no**.

This is a microscopic image, likely a Ziehl-Neelsen stain, showing acid-fast bacilli (the small red rods) among a background of inflammatory cells (the blue areas). An "abdomen" is a large anatomical region of the body and cannot be seen at this magnification.
